svg.title: Lab 04 — Central DHCP server through a relay
svg.desc: DHCP discovery is a broadcast and routers stop broadcasts; the relay agent converts it to a unicast the server can answer
svg.text: Lab 04 — Central DHCP server through a relay
DHCP discovery is a broadcast and routers stop broadcasts; the relay agent converts it to a unicast the server can answer
relay delivers it on the client's LAN
REQUEST and ACK follow the same relayed path
In Simulation mode filter DHCP: the first packet is a broadcast, the second is addressed to 192.168.20.10.
Without ip helper-address the Discover dies at Router0 and clients self-assign 169.254.x.x.
